name: Peligent AI Assistant
author: peligent

sections.description:
Peligent – WordPress AI Co-Pilot That Knows Your Website, Monitors It, and Never Sleeps

Peligent is built for WordPress and WooCommerce store owners who want to spend less time managing their website and more time growing it. It gives you a chat assistant that already knows your store, plus a team of AI bots running in the background — monitoring, analyzing, and reporting back to you automatically.

We built Peligent beca
use running a website takes too many hours. Uploading products, editing images, writing descriptions, and checking orders should be easier.
This plugin brings AI into your website admin to support you with the power of AI.
‍
What You Can Do With Peligent AI Assistant
Your AI Bot Team
Set it and forget it. These bots run on a schedule so your store is always covered, even when you’re offline.

Retention Bot (Monthly) — Analyzes customer retention, identifies churn risks, and delivers a report with actionable tips to keep customers coming back.

Speed Monitor Bot (Weekly) — Checks your page load times, flags slowdowns, and pinpoints the exact cause before it starts costing you sales.

Growth Advisor Bot (Weekly) — Reviews your store performance and surfaces growth opportunities with clear, data-driven recommendations.

Plugin Health Bot (Daily) — Scans your plugins and tech stack for conflicts, outdated versions, and broken integrations, then alerts you with fix recommendations.

Error Log Bot (Daily) — Reviews your WordPress and WooCommerce error logs, spots recurring patterns, and suggests concrete fixes for issues you might never have noticed.
More bots are on the way.

Product Image Background Removal
Upload a regular product image, Peligent AI assistant takes care of the rest, it removes the background automatically using AI, and creates a clean, professional-looking product image with a studio-style background that fits your business and industry.

Write Product Descriptions Faster

Generate clear, professional product descriptions using AI.

Instead of staring at a blank, you can create product content in seconds and adjust it to match your tone and store style.

Ask Questions About Your Store
Use the AI chat assistant directly inside your WordPress admin area.

You can ask questions about your store, including:
* Current orders
* Order status
* Store related information

The assistant is available in a sidebar, so you never need to leave your dashboard.

Works in Multiple Languages

Peligent AI Assistant supports multiple languages, making it useful for website owners and teams around the world.

If you can use WordPress, you can use Peligent.

This Is Just the Beginning

We are actively working on new features that will help you manage your website faster, automate more tasks, and reduce the time spent on daily admin work.

Built With Your Feedback

Peligent is built for the WordPress community.

If you have ideas on how AI can help you manage your website or online store, email us at support@peligent.com.
We take feedback seriously, and we are committed to ongoing improvements and regular updates.

Install Peligent AI Assistant and spend less time managing your website and more time growing it.

How it works

After activation, visit WooCommerce → Peligent. Paste your Peligent Connect Secret, click “Save & Connect to Peligent”. The plugin saves the secret, generates/uses the stored credentials, and sends them to Peligent.

External services

This plugin connects to the Peligent service at https://app.peligent.com to provide AI-powered features for your WooCommerce store. All communication is over HTTPS.

When you connect your store

When you click “Save & Connect to Peligent”, the plugin sends your store URL, WooCommerce API credentials, and an application user to Peligent so we can communicate with your store securely. Basic site information (WordPress version, plugin version) is also shared at this time to help us provide compatible service.

Ongoing data sync

Once connected, the plugin automatically sends product and order updates to Peligent when changes happen in your store. This keeps your AI assistant up to date with your latest catalog and orders. Order data may include customer details (names, email addresses, shipping information) as part of the order record.

Dashboard features

Several plugin pages (Bulk Update, Bots, Reports, Action History, and the AI chat sidebar) load content from app.peligent.com in embedded frames within your WordPress admin. These frames may request microphone access if you use voice input with the AI assistant.

Your control

You can disconnect from Peligent at any time from the plugin settings page, which stops all data sharing. Uninstalling the plugin removes all stored credentials and settings.

Service provider: Peligent
– Terms of Service: https://peligent.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://peligent.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Peligent.
  4. Paste your Peligent Connect Secret.
  5. Click “Save & Connect to Peligent” and follow the redirect to your Peligent dashboard.
sections.faq:
Where do I find the Peligent Connect Secret?

In your Peligent dashboard under Websites → Connect Secret.

What capabilities does the generated user have?

The plugin creates a limited user with only the specific capabilities needed to manage WooCommerce products, orders, and uploads. It does not have full administrator access. You can revoke it from the settings page at any time.

Is data sent securely?

Yes. The plugin posts over HTTPS to https://app.peligent.com with your Connect Secret in the X-Peligent-Connect-Token header.
